Author: Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi
Bench: Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi
 In The High Court Of Jharkhand, Ranchi
 A.B.A. No. 2724 of 2024
 Prakash Yadav ...Petitioner
 Versus
 The State of Jharkhand ...Opposite Party
 ---
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sanjay Kumar Dwivedi
---

For the Petitioner : Mr. Abhay Shankar Dayal, Advocate For State : Mr. Pankaj Kr. Mishra, Advocate For the opposite party no. 2 : Mr. Pawan Kumar Singh, Advocate Mr. Kishore Kunal, Advocate ---
02/16.05.2024 Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner as well as the learned counsel for the respondent State.

2. The petitioner is apprehending his arrest in connection with Kolebira P.S. Case No. 10 of 2024,
for the offence registered under sections 376/506 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Simdega.
3.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the informant is major.
They have come into the friendship on the Facebook.
He submits that anything has taken place is consensual in nature.
He submits that the petitioner has also filed information petition before the learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Ranchi being informatory being M.C.A. No. 7748 of 2023.
4. Learned State counsel opposed the prayer on the ground that allegations are there.
5. Learned counsel for the Opposite party no. 2 submits that on the false pretext of marriage the relationship was established.

6. Looking into the contents of the First Information Report, it transpires that the petitioner and the informant has developed the friendship with the face book and several times they have met in the particular place, it appears that whatever has happened is consensual in nature, I am inclined to provide privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

sentences.text: Accordingly, the petitioner, above named, is hereby directed to surrender before the learned court within three weeks from today, and in the event of his surrender/arrest, the petitioner, above named, shall be 1 of 2 released on bail, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/- (Rupees Twenty Five Thousand), with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Simdega, in connection with Kolebira P.S. Case No. 10 of 2024, subject to the conditions as laid down under section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
